doc: E8 P3 configuration (prototype). To validate fleet_mc (H8), run it with exactly these parameters and write results/sim_proto_mc.csv with columns mode,V,delta_s,lambda,metric,mc_mean (metrics: miss_per_token, miss_lat_mean_ms, wait_all_mean_ms, wait_all_p99_ms, root_bytes_per_token); then run experiments/proto/validate.py.
edge_share: Zipf alpha=0.8 over V edges, w_v proportional to 1/(v+1)^0.8, NOT permuted; each token's session uses ONE edge (no moves)
shield_tier: none: every edge root miss fetches directly from the root service (edge->origin RTT measured, results/proto_rtt.csv path=edge_origin)
issuance: Poisson arrivals over a 60 s window; fixed timer-Delta epochs (random phase); empty epochs produce no root
token_receipt_to_first_request: lognormal median 120 ms sigma 0.5 (plus constant network delays common to all tokens of an epoch)
segments_per_session: 1 manifest + K, K geometric on {1,2,...} mean 20, 200 ms apart (all hits after the first request)
root_fetch_latency: measured keep-alive HTTP RTT edge->origin (results/proto_rtt.csv) + Go ML-DSA-44 root verify (results/proto_go_verify.csv op=verify_root_mldsa44)
staple: pull_staple: first request of every session carries X-EMBER-Root; a miss costs one root verify, no RTT
tenants: each (mode, lambda) pipeline is its own kid/tenant with its own V virtual edges
